subject: Post-call: Exec recap & procurement path — Helix Pharma
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Emily Carter <emily.carter@helixpharma.com>, Jonathan Khan <jonathan.khan@helixpharma.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Exec recap & procurement path — Helix Pharma

Hi Emily / Jonathan,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciated the candid conversation. Per our call, wanted to confirm the executive-level summary, the key pain points you described, and the next steps to move procurement forward. I’ve kept this short for your leadership team.

Executive summary (tl;dr)
- Goal: Reduce cost-per-inference for internal Gen-AI assistant while improving latency for clinical search workflows.
- Timeline: 90-day pilot with production-readiness decision by end of Q3.
- Primary risks: compliance (data residency & SOC 2), procurement timeline, and potential latency SLAs for clinical workflows.

What we heard (pain & goals)
- Cost: model spend is growing fast; current infra is >$X/token for nightly batch jobs. You need a predictable unit economics story.
- Latency: sub-300ms 95th percentile for short retrieval+generate flows is a hard requirement for clinician UX.
- Compliance: must pass a security review (SOC 2 evidence, VPC/private deployment options, audit logs).
- Procurement: prefer a single PO and standard MSA; procurement lead will do a standard vendor questionnaire.

Proposed pilot & success metrics
- Pilot scope: 2-week technical POC (integration + perf/latency tests) followed by 90-day pilot on Dedicated capacity for 100k inference/month.
- Metrics: 95th pctl latency < 300ms, cost delta <= 40% vs current baseline, and zero production data leakage (audit logs enabled).

Procurement path & timeline
1) Security review: you requested SOC 2 summary and architecture diagram — attached.
2) Commercial: we’ll provide a pilot SOW + price for the Dedicated pool.
3) PO & MSA: standard Redwood MSA + PO; if there are redlines we can triage with legal.
4) Exec approval: your sponsor (Emily) to sign-off on pilot budget and timeline.

Escalation items (if any)
- If security team requests on-prem/on-airgap options, that will extend timeline (we flagged Private deployment as an option).
- If latency targets can’t be met in the POC, we’ll propose routing critical flows to a lower-latency variant and/or model quantization.

Next steps (owners & dates)
- Laura to share SOC 2 summary, architecture diagram, and pilot SOW by EOD Tue (attached).
- Helix: confirm procurement contact and preferred PO process by Wed, May 12.
- Marissa to scope Dedicated capacity estimate and pricing (by Wed).

Attachments: redwood-exec-recap-helix.pdf (this recap), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (SOC 2 summary).

Thanks — available if you want a quick 15-min follow-up to walk procurement team through the SOW.

Best,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

---

Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (SOC 2 summary, 2 pages)

Cc: Jonathan Khan <jonathan.khan@helixpharma.com>, procurement@helixpharma.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:07:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call: Exec recap & procurement path — Helix Pharma

Laura — thanks for the concise recap. This matches our notes and is helpful for the exec briefing. A few quick asks from my side before we loop procurement formally: 

1) Can you share a short list of customers in regulated healthcare (just names + one-line use case)?
2) We need a SOC 2 report or AICPA letter — the summary is useful but our security team will likely request formal artifact. Is that available?
3) Pilot pricing — ballpark numbers for the Dedicated pool so I can socialise with my CFO.

Procurement will join once we have the SOW + pricing.

I’ll confirm PO process by Wed EOD.

Thanks,
Emily
Dr. Emily Carter
VP, Clinical AI | Helix Pharma
emily.carter@helixpharma.com

Laura — procurement here. For onboarding we need:
- SOW with deliverables and timeline (PDF)
- Standard MSA (we will review; put commercial terms in SOW)
- W-9 (for US vendors) and standard vendor contact info
- SOC 2 report or evidence link (if available)

Targeting internal approval for a pilot PO by May 24. Send all docs to this address and cc Emily/Jonathan.

Regards,
Helix Procurement
procurement@helixpharma.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: Exec recap & procurement path — Helix Pharma

Looping you in — procurement confirmed items and a tentative PO date of May 24. Action items for our side: 

- Marissa: finalize pilot SOW + line-item pricing (Dedicated 100k inferences/month, 90-day pilot). Need by EOD Thu so we can share with Helix procurement.
- Sean: pull a short customer list (3 healthcare/regulatory customers and 1 pager each) and see if we can get permission to share. Also confirm W-9 availability.
- Laura: assemble SOC 2 report links and the architecture diagram; prepare a one-page exec summary (I attached the recap PDF).

If procurement asks for faster turnaround we may need to propose a limited-scope POC with clear rollback. Will book a 30-min prep with you both at 11:00 PT.

Thanks — laura
